verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents ACID transactions spanning graph, vector, and text data in a single transaction, and an operation-tree request model that traverses and filters candidate sets. Together these imply multi-item operations within one request, but nothing explicitly documents bulk insert, update, or delete. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch write APIs or SDK batch helpers, documentation of set-based mutations across many items, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk operation behavior.
